summary: Procure LegatoSign private-instance (EU residency) + SCIM/Okta + HSM KMS integration
description: Issue summary: Request procurement and onboarding for LegatoSign private-instance to support EU data residency for legal/contracts team. Background: Legal and Sales require an e-signature provider that can host data in the EU, provide HSM-backed key management, and support SCIM provisioning via Okta. Current state: We're using a shared tenant of a different vendor that does not meet EU residency requirements for cross-border deals. Business justification: Required to close several enterprise deals (GDPR/data residency clauses) and to standardize contract signing workflows for compliance-sensitive customers.
impact: Teams impacted: Legal, Sales, Finance, Security. Risk if delayed: 2-3 enterprise deals in pipeline at risk of being delayed or lost; manual workaround (PDF + courier) increases cycle-time and audit burden.
requirements:
1) Dedicated private-instance hosted in eu-west region (data-at-rest in EU).
2) HSM-backed key management (customer-managed or vendor KMS with FIPS 140-2/HSM attestations).
3) Okta SCIM provisioning for users + group sync.
4) Audit logs with 365-day retention export to SIEM.
5) IP allowlist / customer-dedicated VPC peering option.
6) DPA and subprocessor list with SOC2/ISO27001 evidence.
7) Support SSO with SAML and option for 2FA enforcement.
acceptance_criteria:
- Signed PO and vendor invoice for private-instance feature.
- Legal countersigned DPA and necessary data-residency amendment.
- SCIM integration tested in staging Org with 10 pilot users.
- Keys provisioned and KMS/HSM attestation received.
- Audit export pipeline validated to Splunk/Honeycomb.
- Billing center and cost center tags applied in vendor invoice.
procurement_details:
Vendor: LegatoSign (vendor contact: maria@legatosign.com).
SKU requested: LegatoSign Private Instance - EU (60 seats) + HSM Add-on + Enterprise Support.
Requested quantity: 60 seats.
Estimated term: 12 months.
Requested billing: Charge to cost center ENG-PLATFORM-2026-Q2 (Finance approval pending).
PO owner: Sasha Kim.
Finance approver: Aaron Patel (assigned in slack).
legal_notes: Legal to review: DPA amendment for EU residency, subprocessor list, data export controls, right-to-audit clause, breach notification SLA (48 hours max), and requirement that encryption keys are under HSM control. Request legal to add a clause prohibiting vendor from replicating EU-held data to non-EU regions without explicit consent.
it_setup_steps:
1) Exchange SAML metadata and SCIM client credentials with LegatoSign.
2) Create Okta app (SCIM provisioning) and map attributes (email, displayName, employeeType).
3) Provision initial pilot group 'legatosign-pilot' with 10 users.
4) Coordinate cert exchange and IP allowlist with vendor.
5) Validate audit log exports to Honeycomb HTTPS ingestion endpoint and Splunk HEC.
6) If using vendor-managed KMS, request attestation docs; if customer-managed, schedule KMS provisioning in HSM and share access methods.
7) Update runbook: /confluence/VendorOnboard/LegatoSign
estimated_cost: €48,000 annually (estimate) - includes private-instance premium and HSM add-on. Final pricing to be confirmed by vendor quote.
